extraction_notes: Only experimental NH3 synthesis performance entries in the SI were extracted. Characterisation figures, activation-energy/reaction-order summaries without rate entries, DFT/work-function data, isotope-exchange conversion tables, and non-this-work literature rows in comparison tables were excluded. Some time-course plots (SI Figures S8 and S9) contain multiple intermediate points; representative final points are included, while exact table values were used where available. Plot-read values are approximate and marked with qualifier '~'.
